mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, e.id AS enrollmentId, u.name AS studentName, u.login_id AS studentLoginId, e.midterm_score AS midtermScore, e.final_score AS finalScore, e.assignment_score AS assignmentScore, e.attendance_score AS attendanceScore, e.grade_status AS status, e.objection_reply AS objectionReply FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.user_id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE e.lecture_id = #{lectureId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollments SET midterm_score = #{dto.midtermScore}, final_score = #{dto.finalScore}, assignment_score = #{dto.assignmentScore}, attendance_score = #{dto.attendanceScore}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{dto.enrollmentId}
UPDATE enrollments SET grade_status = #{status}, objection_reply = #{objectionReply}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{gradeId}
